objects.name: cfg__SystemConfigurations
objects.sqlite_sql:
CREATE TABLE "cfg__SystemConfigurations" (
  "ConfigurationId" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  "ConfigurationKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "ConfigurationValue" TEXT,
  "ValueType" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "Category" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "StorageType" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PLAIN',
  "Description" TEXT,
  "DefaultValue" TEXT,
  "MinNumericValue" NUMERIC,
  "MaxNumericValue" NUMERIC,
  "AllowedValuesJson" TEXT,
  "ValidationPattern" TEXT,
  "RequiresApproval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("RequiresApproval" IN (0,1)),
  "VersionNumber" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  "IsActive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("IsActive" IN (0,1)),
  "IsSystem" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("IsSystem" IN (0,1)),
  "IsEditable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("IsEditable" IN (0,1)),
  "IsSensitive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("IsSensitive" IN (0,1)),
  "RequiresRestart" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("RequiresRestart" IN (0,1)),
  "CreatedAtUtc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  "CreatedByUserId" INTEGER,
  "UpdatedAtUtc" TEXT,
  "UpdatedByUserId" INTEGER,
  "RowVersion" BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT (randomblob(8)) CHECK (length("RowVersion")=8),
  UNIQUE ("ConfigurationKey"),
  CHECK (ValueType IN ('STRING','INTEGER','BOOLEAN','DECIMAL','JSON')),
  CHECK (StorageType IN ('PLAIN','KEYVAULT_REFERENCE')),
  CHECK (MinNumericValue IS NULL OR MaxNumericValue IS NULL OR MinNumericValue<=MaxNumericValue),
  CHECK (VersionNumber>=1),
  CHECK (AllowedValuesJson IS NULL OR json_valid(AllowedValuesJson)),
  CHECK (ValueType<>'JSON' OR ConfigurationValue IS NULL OR json_valid(ConfigurationValue))
)

objects.name: leg__LegalDocumentVersions
objects.sqlite_sql:
CREATE TABLE "leg__LegalDocumentVersions" (
  "DocumentVersionId" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
  "LegalDocumentId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "VersionIdentifier" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "Title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "EffectiveAtUtc" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "PublicationStatus" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "StorageReference" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "ContentHash" BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (length("ContentHash")=32),
  "MimeType" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "FileSizeBytes" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "CreatedAtUtc" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
  "CreatedByUserId" INTEGER,
  "ApprovedAtUtc" TEXT,
  "ApprovedByUserId" INTEGER,
  "PublishedAtUtc" TEXT,
  "PublishedByUserId" INTEGER,
  "ArchivedAtUtc" TEXT,
  "ArchivedByUserId" INTEGER,
  "RowVersion" BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT (randomblob(8)) CHECK (length("RowVersion")=8),
  "SubmittedAtUtc" TEXT,
  "SubmittedByUserId" INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY ("DocumentVersionId"),
  UNIQUE ("LegalDocumentId","VersionIdentifier"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("LegalDocumentId") REFERENCES "leg__LegalDocuments" ("LegalDocumentId"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("CreatedByUserId") REFERENCES "iam__Users" ("UserId"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("ApprovedByUserId") REFERENCES "iam__Users" ("UserId"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("PublishedByUserId") REFERENCES "iam__Users" ("UserId"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("ArchivedByUserId") REFERENCES "iam__Users" ("UserId"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("SubmittedByUserId") REFERENCES "iam__Users" ("UserId"),
  CHECK (MimeType='application/pdf' AND FileSizeBytes>0),
  CHECK (length(StorageReference)=32 AND StorageReference NOT GLOB '*[^0-9A-Fa-f]*'),
  CHECK ((PublicationStatus='DRAFT' AND ApprovedAtUtc IS NULL AND PublishedAtUtc IS NULL AND ArchivedAtUtc IS NULL) OR (PublicationStatus='PENDING_APPROVAL' AND SubmittedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND ApprovedAtUtc IS NULL AND PublishedAtUtc IS NULL AND ArchivedAtUtc IS NULL) OR (PublicationStatus='APPROVED' AND ApprovedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND PublishedAtUtc IS NULL AND ArchivedAtUtc IS NULL) OR (PublicationStatus='PUBLISHED' AND ApprovedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND PublishedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND ArchivedAtUtc IS NULL) OR (PublicationStatus='ARCHIVED' AND ApprovedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND PublishedAtUtc IS NOT NULL AND ArchivedAtUtc IS NOT NULL))
)

objects.name: trg_NotificationTemplateVersions_ActiveImmutable
objects.sqlite_sql: CREATE TRIGGER trg_NotificationTemplateVersions_ActiveImmutable BEFORE UPDATE ON ntf__NotificationTemplateVersions WHEN OLD.StatusCode IN('ACTIVE','ARCHIVED') AND (NEW.TemplateVersionId IS NOT OLD.TemplateVersionId OR NEW.TemplateId IS NOT OLD.TemplateId OR NEW.TemplateCode IS NOT OLD.TemplateCode OR NEW.VersionNumber IS NOT OLD.VersionNumber OR NEW.Subject IS NOT OLD.Subject OR NEW.Body IS NOT OLD.Body OR NEW.CreatedByUserId IS NOT OLD.CreatedByUserId OR NEW.CreatedAtUtc IS NOT OLD.CreatedAtUtc OR NEW.SubmittedAtUtc IS NOT OLD.SubmittedAtUtc OR NEW.ActivatedAtUtc IS NOT OLD.ActivatedAtUtc OR (OLD.StatusCode='ACTIVE' AND (NEW.StatusCode NOT IN('ACTIVE','ARCHIVED') OR (NEW.StatusCode='ACTIVE' AND NEW.ArchivedAtUtc IS NOT OLD.ArchivedAtUtc) OR (NEW.StatusCode='ARCHIVED' AND NEW.ArchivedAtUtc IS NULL))) OR (OLD.StatusCode='ARCHIVED' AND (NEW.StatusCode<>'ARCHIVED' OR NEW.ArchivedAtUtc IS NOT OLD.ArchivedAtUtc))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Active and archived versions immutable'); END
